test_results.create_sql: CREATE TABLE test_results (sample_name TEXT NOT NULL, test_name TEXT NOT NULL, p_value REAL NOT NULL, pass INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sample_name, test_name))

columns.sample_name: TEXT NOT NULL — name of the binary sample file
columns.test_name: TEXT NOT NULL — test name from the tests list above
columns.p_value: REAL NOT NULL — test p-value in [0,1]
columns.pass: INTEGER NOT NULL — 1 if p_value >= 0.01, else 0

classifications.create_sql: CREATE TABLE classifications (sample_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generator_type TEXT NOT NULL)

columns.sample_name: TEXT PRIMARY KEY — name of the binary sample file
columns.generator_type: TEXT NOT NULL — one of the generator_types listed below

notes.no_prebuilt_libraries: All tests must be implemented from scratch. scipy/numpy allowed for special functions (erfc, gammaincc) and FFT only.
